name: CommuteAssistFindHardwareStore

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a short scene where a person in their car asks their assistant to find a nearby hardware or DIY store. They need something specific. Sigma finds the nearest option and gives directions. Keep it brief.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Car driving sounds, suburban roads, weekend errand drive, city outskirts

initial_prompt: Generate a short driving errand scene. The person is in their car and needs to find a hardware or DIY shop — they need something like a drill bit, some paint, filler, or tape. They ask Sigma for the nearest option. Sigma gives the closest one with rough directions. One possible follow-up about opening hours or size of the store.

variations.context: Finding a hardware or DIY store while driving on the weekend

setting.mood: Practical, weekend mode, on a mission
setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo driver doing a home improvement errand
setting.background: Middle of a home project, realised they need something from a hardware shop. Nearest big chain is probably fine.
setting.conversation_style: One request, one option from Sigma, maybe a quick follow-up, then navigation.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks Sigma for the nearest DIY or hardware store
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, nearest B&Q from here?' or 'Sigma, is there a hardware shop nearby?' or 'Sigma, any Homebase around here?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives nearest store name, distance, and possibly a note on size
scenario_template.mood: Processing, deciding if it's worth it
scenario_template.note: Sigma: store name + distance. One or two sentences. Driver: quick reaction.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks for directions or checks if it's open
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. 'Sigma, is it open now?' or 'Sigma, navigate me there.'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma confirms or gives first direction. Driver heads there.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one sentence. Driver: brief acknowledgement.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo driver doing a home improvement errand
setting.background: On the way to a DIY party, they need extra supplies.
setting.conversation_style: One request, one option from Sigma, maybe a quick follow-up, then navigation.

scenario_template.topic: They urgently ask Sigma for the nearest place to buy more party-related supplies.
Sigma provides the closest store, highlighting its large selection.
They ask if it is open late given the time in the evening.
Sigma confirms it is open and directs them there.

user1.role: Driver on a weekend errand for home improvement supplies. Uses Sigma to find the nearest shop. Direct and practical — no deliberating.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Local search assistant. Gives store name, distance, and opening status when asked. Directions if needed. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Driver is on a practical errand — no fuss.
Sigma gives store name + distance, nothing more unless asked.
Driver doesn't explain the whole home project.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma gives store name, distance, or hours — one at a time.
No recommendations or alternatives unless asked.
